description: Malformed and boundary responses for the HTTP/1.1 client parser (design 10.2). input chunks are hex, or {fill, count} for long runs. context.method defaults to GET; context.upgrade means the request asked for a WebSocket upgrade with that key (and protocol); context.eof means the stream ends after the input; the body cap is 8 MiB.

cases.name: 101 to a request that asked for no upgrade
control character in a field value
chunks adding up past the cap
a trailer after the last chunk
an empty line before the status line
101 and the first frame in one chunk
a close-delimited body read to EOF
HEAD with Content-Length reads no body
